sentences.latin: Nauta insulam parvam petit.
sentences.english: The sailor makes for a small island.

sentences.latin: In insula nauta amicum videt.
sentences.english: On the island, the sailor sees a friend.

sentences.latin: Amicus nautae equum bonum habet.
sentences.english: The sailor's friend has a good horse.

sentences.latin: Nauta et amicus equum ducunt.
sentences.english: The sailor and the friend lead the horse.

sentences.latin: Nauta piscem videt et amicum vocat.
sentences.english: The sailor sees a fish and calls the friend.

sentences.latin: Amicus piscem parvum capit.
sentences.english: The friend catches a small fish.

sentences.latin: Nauta amicum bonum laudat.
sentences.english: The sailor praises the good friend.

sentences.latin: Pater noster fratri et sorori libros dat.
sentences.english: Our father gives books to the brother and the sister.

sentences.latin: Frater et soror libros suos novos aperiunt.
sentences.english: The brother and the sister open their own new books.

sentences.latin: Soror fratri verba dulcia in libro scribit.
sentences.english: In a book, the sister writes sweet words to the brother.

sentences.latin: Mater nostra sorori et fratri cibum bonum parat.
sentences.english: Our mother prepares good food for the sister and the brother.

sentences.latin: Cibus a fratre et sorore laudatur.
sentences.english: The food is praised by the brother and the sister.

sentences.latin: Pater fratrem et sororem sapientes monet.
sentences.english: The father warns the wise brother and sister.

sentences.latin: Itaque frater et soror patri fideli credunt.
sentences.english: And so the brother and the sister trust the faithful father.

sentences.latin: Gladiator ferox et fortis hostem in proelio magno petit.
sentences.english: The fierce and brave gladiator attacks the enemy in the great battle.

sentences.latin: Centurio iustus legionis nostrae gladiatorem clarum et fortem magna voce laudat.
sentences.english: The just centurion of our legion praises the famous and brave gladiator with a loud voice.

sentences.latin: Scutum gladiatoris ferocis et fortis ab hoste forti capitur.
sentences.english: The shield of the fierce and brave gladiator is captured by the brave enemy.

sentences.latin: Sed centurio fortis et sapiens novum scutum magnum gladiatori dat.
sentences.english: But the brave and wise centurion gives a large new shield to the gladiator.

sentences.latin: Gladiator scuto novo et magno hostem ferocem terret.
sentences.english: The gladiator frightens the fierce enemy with the new, large shield.

sentences.latin: Itaque victoria magna et praeclara a legione nostra fideli servatur.
sentences.english: And so the great and illustrious victory is preserved by our faithful legion.
